translations.translatedText: # Radio | Clear News | Thursday 31.8.2023
Anti-racism statement. Denial of the Holocaust. Food prices. Disability services act. Name days. Weather forecast.
## Anti-racism statement

![Chair of the National Coalition Party, Prime Minister Petteri Orpo, comments to the media at a press conference that dealt with the statement for promoting equality, equal rights and non-discrimination, in Helsinki .](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5110,h_2868,x_0,y_320/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-116549964f07da7ba7c5/1693559342)
Open image viewer
Prime Minister Petteri Orpo told about the government's statement. Photo: Markku Ulander / Lehtikuva
The government has approved the anti-racism statement.
This means that the government has agreed on how the government will fight racism.
Prime Minister **Petteri Orpo** says that every government minister distances themselves from racism, and every minister commits to working against racism.
## Denial of the Holocaust

![A girl with her back to the camera at the memorial to the 1943 Treblinka uprising.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4096,h_2304,x_0,y_287/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-106480263d39c354f169/1674812563)
Open image viewer
The Treblinka concentration camp in Poland was one of the places where Jews were killed. Photo: EPA-EFE
The government has announced new anti-racism measures. The government will launch a programme to develop equality and equal rights in all schools and educational institutions.
The aim is, for example, to get more children from immigrant families to take part in early childhood education than now.

The government also wants to prevent hate crimes against Jews, Muslims, Christians and other religious groups. The aim is that, for example, denial of the Holocaust will be dealt with by law. Some people deny the mass murder of Jews, the Holocaust, during the Second World War. The aim is that in future, denial will be illegal.
## Food prices
![A customer carries a shopping basket in a grocery store.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5568,h_3132,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-774563602b9bbe33527/1613471412)
Open image viewer
Food prices have risen, but the rise has slowed down a little. Photo: Tiina Jutila / Yle
Food prices have risen a lot over the year. In July, food cost over 8 percent more than in July last year.
However, the rise has slowed down. This is what the trade association PTY says.

During the whole early part of the year, that is from January to July, food prices rose almost 13 percent compared with the January to July period last year. So in July, food prices rose a little more slowly than earlier this year.
## Disability services act

![Close-up of wheelchair wheels and the legs of the person sitting in it.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2014,h_1134,x_0,y_378/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-114358864b500a12c54a/1693482950)
Open image viewer
The disability services act may take effect at the beginning of 2025. Photo: Katja Halinen
The government wants to postpone the entry into force of the disability services act again. The government still wants to change which matters, persons or organisations the act applies to.
Originally the disability services act was to take effect this autumn. In the government negotiations it was agreed that the act would be postponed by 1 year, to next year's autumn.
Now the government wants to move the disability services act a little more, so that it takes effect at the beginning of 2025.
## Name days
![Name day calendar](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4128,h_2322,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/17-2026554ec8467137d2/1424786541)
Open image viewer
New names are added to the calendar every year. Names that are not used much are removed from the calendar. Photo: Yle/Anna Keränen
New name days will again be added to the Finnish calendar. The University of Helsinki says that 33 new names will be added to the 2025 calendar.
Some of the names are old names that return to the calendar after a break. Examples of these are the names Aamos, Linus and Rolf.
International names will also be added to the Finnish calendar. Examples of these are Amelia, Jare, Jasu, Kevin and Neo.
## The weather
![Friday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-116574164f0a60854874/1693492780)
Open image viewer
Friday is quite warm across the whole country.
On Friday, it will generally rain in Lapland. Elsewhere there will be showers in places. The temperature is around 20 degrees, and it is cooler in Lapland.
